# MODEL: One agent, 4 states (s0-s3), where the Demon's budget decides OL formulas.

# PURPOSE: OL semantics of ECAI 2023: each step the Demon disables edges whose
# costs sum to at most the bound, never all edges of a state.

# LOGIC: OL

# DESCRIPTION: s0 has three edges: to s1 (bad, cost 2), to s2 (goal, cost 1) and
# to s3 (bad, cost 1). Keeping every path out of bad from s0 means disabling the
# edges to s1 and s3, which costs 3. s1, s2 and s3 only loop.

Transition
0 A B C
0 D 0 0
0 0 E 0
0 0 0 H

Name_State
s0 s1 s2 s3
Initial_State
s0
Costs_for_actions
A s0$2
B s0$1
C s0$1
D s1$1
E s2$1
H s3$1
Atomic_propositions
goal bad
Labelling
0 0
0 1
1 0
0 1
Number_of_agents
1
